items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: playing Charlie Christian solos over and over

ctx.x: Yeah, it was. My father was a jazz guitarist and a very good one. And my mother was a vocal music teacher and piano major and taught piano and taught music, actually was my music teacher in elementary school when I was going to school. So yeah, I grew up listening to a lot of great jazz records, from the time I was very little. And I think I certainly got my passion for the music from my father, because he was very passionate,
playing Charlie Christian solos over and over, and tears running down his eyes, you know, things like that.
